## Summary

Describe the user-facing change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] I tested empty records and source-unavailable behavior where relevant.

## Data and privacy review

- [ ] Any dataset or field change links to official documentation.
- [ ] This change does not create a safety ranking, use protected characteristics, or expose personal information.
